zh: 有人找你。
en: Someone's here to see you.
alt: There's someone here to see you.
Someone's looking for you.
point: “有人找你”不是 Have someone find you，用 someone's here to see you

zh: 今天下午有个会。
en: There's a meeting this afternoon.
alt: We've got a meeting this afternoon.
point: “有个会”用 there's a meeting 或 we've got，不说 has a meeting

zh: 这个版本有个bug。
en: There's a bug in this version.
alt: This version has a bug.
point: “X有Y”英文常说 there's Y in X

zh: 你电脑上有Python吗？
en: Have you got Python on your computer?
alt: Is Python installed on your computer?
Do you have Python on your computer?
point: 问“你有…吗”用 Have you got / Do you have

zh: 还有空桌吗？
en: Have you got any tables free?
alt: Are there any tables free?
Is there a table free?
point: 问店家“还有…吗”用 Have you got any…? / Are there any…?

zh: 这道菜里有花生吗？
en: Are there peanuts in this dish?
alt: Does this dish have peanuts in it?
Has this got peanuts in it?
point: 问食材用 Are there … in it?，介词 in 不能漏

zh: 今晚有橄榄球比赛。
en: There's a rugby game on tonight.
alt: The rugby's on tonight.
point: 比赛、节目“有”说 there's … on，on 表示在进行/上演

zh: 健身房有游泳池吗？
en: Has the gym got a pool?
alt: Does the gym have a pool?
Is there a pool at the gym?
point: 设施用 has got / have，或 Is there … at …?

zh: 这附近有超市吗？
en: Is there a supermarket near here?
alt: Is there a supermarket around here?
point: “附近有…吗”用 Is there … near here?，不说 Have supermarket

zh: 这件有小号的吗？
en: Have you got this in a small?
alt: Do you have this in a small?
Does this come in a small?
point: 问尺码说 Have you got this in a small?，用 in

zh: 机场有免费Wi-Fi吗？
en: Is there free Wi-Fi at the airport?
alt: Does the airport have free Wi-Fi?
point: “某地有…吗”用 Is there … at …?

zh: 前面有车祸。
en: There's been a crash up ahead.
alt: There's an accident up ahead.
point: 刚发生的事故常说 there's been a crash，用完成时

zh: 我有点发烧。
en: I've got a bit of a temperature.
alt: I've got a slight fever.
I'm running a bit of a temperature.
point: 症状用 I've got，口语常说 a temperature

zh: 我腿上有个包。
en: I've got a lump on my leg.
alt: There's a lump on my leg.
point: 身上“有个包”说 I've got a lump on…，不说 my leg has a bag

zh: 冰箱里没牛奶了。
en: There's no milk left in the fridge.
alt: We're out of milk.
We've run out of milk.
point: “没…了”用 there's no … left 或 we're out of

zh: 门口有个包裹。
en: There's a parcel at the door.
alt: There's a package by the door.
point: 地点放句末：There's a parcel at the door

zh: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？
en: Have you got any brothers or sisters?
alt: Do you have any siblings?
point: 问家人加 any；“兄弟姐妹”口语说 brothers or sisters

zh: 周六有个派对，你来吗？
en: There's a party on Saturday. Are you keen?
alt: There's a party on Saturday, are you coming?
point: “有个派对”用 there's；Kiwi 问“来吗”常说 Are you keen?

zh: 你有零钱吗？
en: Have you got any change?
alt: Do you have any coins?
point: 零钱说 change，问“有…吗”用 Have you got any…?

zh: 我卡里没钱了。
en: There's nothing left in my account.
alt: I've got no money left on my card.
My account's empty.
point: “没钱了”说 there's nothing left，不说 my card no money

zh: 我们公司大概有两百人，大部分在奥克兰。
en: Our company's got about 200 staff, mostly based in Auckland.
alt: There are about 200 people in our company, most of them in Auckland.
We have around 200 employees, mostly in Auckland.
point: “公司有200人”用 has got 或 there are，不说 our company have

zh: 下周一有个新同事来报到。
en: There's a new team member starting next Monday.
alt: We've got someone new starting next Monday.
point: “有人来报到”说 there's someone starting，报到用 start

zh: 日志里有好几个报错，但系统还在运行。
en: There are a few errors in the logs, but the system's still running.
alt: The logs show several errors, but the system is still up.
point: 复数用 there are，不说 there have

zh: 服务器上还有足够的空间吗？我得上传一些文件。
en: Is there enough space left on the server? I need to upload some files.
alt: Have we got enough room on the server? I've got some files to upload.
point: “还有空间吗”用 Is there … left，left 表示剩下

zh: 菜单上有没有素的？我朋友不吃肉。
en: Is there anything vegetarian on the menu? My friend doesn't eat meat.
alt: Have you got any vegetarian options? My friend doesn't eat meat.
point: “有没有…”不用重复，说 Is there anything … on the menu?

zh: 这家店周末总是有很多人排队。
en: There's always a queue outside this place on weekends.
alt: There's always a long line here at the weekend.
point: “有人排队”说 there's a queue，不说 many people line up

zh: 周六公园里有个免费的跑步活动，要不要一起去？
en: There's a free fun run in the park on Saturday. Want to come along?
alt: There's a free running event in the park this Saturday, are you keen to join?
point: “有个活动”用 there's；邀请说 Want to come along?

zh: 我们队里有两个人受伤了，所以这周人不够。
en: We've got two players injured, so we're short this week.
alt: Two of our players are injured, so we haven't got enough people this week.
point: “队里有人受伤”说 we've got two players injured；人不够 short

zh: Countdown今天有打折，牛排半价。
en: There's a sale on at Countdown today, and steak's half price.
alt: Countdown's got a sale on today, steak is half price.
point: “有打折”说 there's a sale on，不说 Countdown has discount

zh: 这件外套有没有别的颜色？黑色有点太暗了。
en: Does this jacket come in any other colours? The black's a bit too dark.
alt: Have you got this jacket in another colour? Black's a bit dark for me.
point: 问颜色说 come in other colours；colour 英式拼写

zh: 从机场到市中心有没有直达的巴士？
en: Is there a direct bus from the airport to the city centre?
alt: Does a bus go straight from the airport into the CBD?
point: “有没有直达巴士”用 Is there a direct bus…；centre 英式拼写

zh: 这个周末皇后镇基本订不到房间了。
en: There are hardly any rooms left in Queenstown this weekend.
alt: Most places in Queenstown are fully booked this weekend.
point: “基本没有”用 there are hardly any … left

zh: 我嗓子有点疼，好像还有点咳嗽。
en: I've got a sore throat and a bit of a cough as well.
alt: My throat's sore and I've got a slight cough too.
point: 症状都用 I've got，不说 my throat has pain

zh: 今天还有没有空的预约？我想看一下医生。
en: Are there any appointments free today? I'd like to see a doctor.
alt: Have you got anything available today? I need to see the GP.
point: 问空档用 Are there any … free；看医生说 see a doctor/GP

zh: 浴室天花板上有一块霉，得找人来看看。
en: There's some mould on the bathroom ceiling, so we need to get someone in.
alt: We've got mould on the bathroom ceiling, and someone needs to look at it.
point: 霉是 mould（英式拼写）；“找人来”说 get someone in

zh: 我们这儿晚上有点吵，因为附近有个酒吧。
en: It's a bit noisy at night because there's a bar just down the road.
alt: Our street gets a bit loud at night, since there's a pub nearby.
point: “附近有个…”用 there's a … down the road / nearby

zh: 你朋友里有没有会说中文的？我室友想找人练口语。
en: Do any of your mates speak Chinese? My flatmate's looking for someone to practise with.
alt: Is there anyone among your friends who speaks Chinese? My flatmate wants to practise speaking.
point: “有没有会…的”说 Do any of your mates…；室友是 flatmate

zh: 天气太好了，公园里有好多人在野餐。
en: It's such a nice day that there are loads of people having picnics in the park.
alt: The park's packed with people having picnics since it's so sunny.
point: there are + 人 + doing，不用 who are

zh: 我这个月还有一笔账单没付，下周到期。
en: I've still got one bill to pay this month, and it's due next week.
alt: There's one bill I haven't paid yet this month; it's due next week.
point: “还有…没付”说 I've still got … to pay；到期用 due

zh: 这张卡有没有年费？我不想每年多付钱。
en: Is there an annual fee on this card? I don't want to pay extra every year.
alt: Does this card have a yearly fee? I don't want to be paying extra each year.
point: “有没有费用”用 Is there a fee on…，介词用 on

zh: 新系统上线以后还有不少问题，我们得在周五之前全部解决。
en: There are still quite a few issues since the new system went live, and we need to sort them all out by Friday.
alt: The new system's still got a fair few problems since go-live, and they all need sorting by Friday.
point: “还有不少问题”说 there are still quite a few；解决口语用 sort out

zh: 关于预算还有其他问题吗？没有的话我们今天就到这儿。
en: Are there any other questions about the budget? If not, let's wrap it up there for today.
alt: Has anyone got any more questions on the budget? If not, we'll leave it there.
point: 会议收尾：Any other questions? If not, let's wrap it up

zh: 这个API有个限制：每分钟最多一百次请求，超过的话会返回429。
en: There's a limit on this API: a hundred requests a minute, and anything over that gets a 429.
alt: The API's got a rate limit of 100 requests per minute; go over it and you'll get a 429.
point: “有个限制”说 there's a limit on；每分钟口语说 a minute

zh: 我们代码里有很多重复的逻辑，有时间的话最好重构一下。
en: There's a lot of duplicated logic in our code, so it'd be worth refactoring when we've got time.
alt: Our codebase has heaps of repeated logic; we should refactor it when there's time.
point: logic 不可数，用 there's a lot of；“最好…”说 it'd be worth

zh: 我们一共有八个人，其中两个是小孩，有没有靠窗的大桌子？
en: There are eight of us, including two kids. Have you got a big table by the window?
alt: We're a group of eight with two children; is there a large table by the window?
point: “我们有八个人”说 There are eight of us，不说 We have eight people

zh: 不好意思，我的汤里好像有根头发，能帮我换一份吗？
en: Sorry, I think there's a hair in my soup. Could I get another one, please?
alt: Excuse me, there seems to be a hair in my soup; could you replace it?
point: “好像有”说 I think there's / there seems to be；a hair 可数

zh: 这个周末伊甸公园有全黑队的比赛，不过票好像已经卖完了。
en: There's an All Blacks game at Eden Park this weekend, but I think it's already sold out.
alt: The All Blacks have got a game at Eden Park this weekend, but apparently the tickets have all gone.
point: “有比赛”用 there's a game；票卖完说 it's sold out

zh: 我们俱乐部有个规定：新会员前三个月每周至少要来训练一次。
en: Our club's got a rule that new members have to come to training at least once a week for the first three months.
alt: There's a rule at our club: new members must train at least once a week for their first three months.
point: “有个规定”说 we've got a rule that… / there's a rule

zh: 我在Warehouse买的水壶有条裂缝，还好收据还在，可以退。
en: The kettle I bought at the Warehouse has got a crack in it, but luckily I've still got the receipt, so I can return it.
alt: There's a crack in the kettle I got from the Warehouse, but I've kept the receipt, so I can take it back.
point: “有裂缝”说 has got a crack in it；退货说 return / take it back

zh: 网上显示这家店有现货，可我到了以后店员说一件都没有了。
en: The website said they had it in stock, but when I got there the staff told me there were none left.
alt: Online it showed as in stock, but once I arrived they said they'd sold out.
point: 有现货说 in stock；“一件都没有了”说 there were none left

zh: 这趟去南岛的航班有托运行李额度吗？我带了不少滑雪装备。
en: Is there a checked baggage allowance on this flight to the South Island? I'm bringing quite a lot of ski gear.
alt: Does the South Island flight include checked luggage? I've got a fair bit of ski gear with me.
point: 行李额度说 baggage allowance；“有没有”用 Is there … on this flight

zh: 酒店说房间里有空调，结果我们到了发现根本没有。
en: The hotel said there'd be air con in the room, but when we got there, there wasn't any.
alt: According to the hotel the room had air conditioning, but it turned out there was none.
point: 转述时 there will be 变 there'd be；“根本没有”说 there wasn't any

zh: 我家族里有糖尿病史，所以医生建议我每年查一次血糖。
en: There's a history of diabetes in my family, so my doctor suggested I get my blood sugar checked every year.
alt: Diabetes runs in my family, so the GP recommended a yearly blood sugar test.
point: “家族有…史”说 there's a history of … in my family

zh: 这个药有一些副作用，比如头晕，所以吃完以后别开车。
en: This medication has a few side effects, like dizziness, so don't drive after you've taken it.
alt: There are some side effects with these pills, such as feeling dizzy, so avoid driving after taking them.
point: “有副作用”说 has side effects；吃药是 take，不是 eat

zh: 厨房水槽下面好像有地方在漏水，你能不能叫房东派个水管工过来？
en: There seems to be a leak under the kitchen sink. Could you ask the landlord to send a plumber round?
alt: I think something's leaking under the kitchen sink; can you get the landlord to send a plumber?
point: “好像有地方漏水”说 there seems to be a leak；派人来说 send … round

zh: 我们家后院地方够大，夏天可以搞个烧烤，把邻居也叫上。
en: There's plenty of room in our backyard, so we could have a BBQ in summer and invite the neighbours.
alt: We've got enough space out the back to have a barbecue with the neighbours in summer.
point: 空间 room 不可数，说 there's plenty of room；neighbours 英式拼写

zh: 我们读书会还有两个空位，你要是认识对这类书感兴趣的人，可以介绍过来。
en: There are still two spots left in our book club, so if you know anyone who's into this sort of thing, send them our way.
alt: Our book club's got two places left; if you know anyone interested, feel free to bring them along.
point: “还有空位”说 there are still … left；介绍过来说 send them our way

zh: 昨晚的聚会有好几个人我不认识，不过大家都挺友好的，聊得很开心。
en: There were quite a few people I didn't know at the party last night, but everyone was really friendly and we had a good chat.
alt: I didn't know a lot of the people at last night's party, but they were all lovely and I had a great time chatting.
point: 过去用 there were；“聊得很开心”说 had a good chat

zh: 这份合同里有一些隐藏费用，签之前你最好把细则仔细看一遍。
en: There are some hidden fees in this contract, so you'd better read the fine print carefully before you sign.
alt: The contract's got a few hidden costs in it; make sure you go through the small print before signing.
point: “有隐藏费用”说 there are hidden fees；细则是 fine print

zh: 我们账户里应该还有五百块左右，够付这个月的电费和网费。
en: There should be about five hundred dollars left in our account, which is enough to cover the power and internet this month.
alt: We should still have around $500 in the account, enough for this month's power and broadband bills.
point: “应该还有”说 there should be … left；付账说 cover，电费 NZ 说 power
